features: COMPACT & PORTABLE: Lightweight wearable camera designed for convenient hands-free recording.
FULL HD RECORDING: Capture clear Full HD 1080p videos for travel, cycling, outdoor activities and daily moments.
MULTIPLE MOUNTING OPTIONS: Includes versatile mounts for helmet, handlebar, clip and other compatible surfaces.

2 Working Modes ◀ Our GPS tracker detector has 2 types of alarms: sound & silent vibration. After turning it on, short press the power button to switch, and you can set the vibration or sound mode according to your needs
HANDS-FREE OPERATION: Wearable lanyard design helps keep the camera accessible while leaving your hands free.
OUTDOOR READY KIT: Comes with multiple mounting accessories and a protective housing for flexible everyday use.
description: Capture your everyday adventures, travel moments, cycling rides and outdoor activities with this compact wearable action camera. Its lightweight design and multiple mounting accessories allow convenient hands-free recording from different angles. The included clip, helmet/handlebar mounts, lanyard and protective housing make it suitable for versatile outdoor use.
